reading.title: REGULATORY AGREEMENT Tollgate Yard · Tollgate Road, Fennick Landing

candidates.quote: 1.1 The Owner shall reserve 30 of the 150 homes at Tollgate Yard as Affordable Homes.
1.2 Each Affordable Home shall be leased to a household with income at or below 70 percent of area median income.
candidates.value: at or below 70 percent of area median income

candidates.quote: 1.3 The requirements of this Agreement shall remain in effect for 25 years from the date the first Affordable Home is leased.
2.1 The Owner shall deliver an annual compliance certificate to the City by April 1 of each year.
2.2 If a default is not cured within 30 days after written notice, the Owner shall repay all reduced taxes with interest.
candidates.value: repay all reduced taxes with interest
